name: Brumal-Gyre
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in an ancient meteor crater. Travelers navigate by a nearby asteroid belt and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Debris from the starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
